Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 11

“In whatever way people approach me, in that same way I favour them. Human beings follow my path in every respect, Partha.”

A remarkably open verse. The response meets the approach on its own terms, which makes room for every temperament without ranking anyone at the door.
